title: The interface is discharged
statement:
By [sk-thm-sf-pf-finite], [sk-prop-sf-pf-reduction],
[sk-thm-sf-pf-adic], [sk-thm-sf-pf-field], [sk-thm-sf-pf-proetale] and
[sk-prop-sf-pf-coherence] every obligation listed in the interface
fix-prop-projection-formula of the framework chapter is discharged, so
that interface is an unconditional statement of this manuscript and the
projection formula is a *theorem* at every coefficient stage. No duality
statement is used anywhere in this subsection: the projection formula concerns the
compatibility of $Rf_!$ with the tensor product and is logically prior to
Verdier duality.

proof.text:
The obligations of the interface are discharged one coefficient stage at a
time. At the finite stages $A_{E,n}$ the projection formula is
[sk-thm-sf-pf-finite], and it is compatible with finite reduction by
[sk-prop-sf-pf-reduction]. At the derived-complete stage $\mathcal O_E$ it is
[sk-thm-sf-pf-adic], obtained from the finite stages by that compatibility.
At $E$ and $\Qlb$ it is [sk-thm-sf-pf-field]. On the pro-étale realization it
is [sk-thm-sf-pf-proetale]. The naturality, unit, associativity and
compactification-independence clauses are [sk-prop-sf-pf-coherence]. None of
these proofs uses a duality statement.
